cliEvidence.routingContract: Installed azext_aigateway/_rp.py SUPPORTED_NEW_COMMANDS, CHILD_READS, and CHILD_WRITES; fingerprinted and inspected without importing code.

limitations: Creates an explicit callable model name. GET-before-PUT is not atomic; no implicit piped/batch alias creation.
Preserve unrelated alias policies and targets; explicit complete backend selection is required.
Creates new gateway-wide caller key metadata, not imported APIM client subscription keys or per-API access. Does not read key values.

Creates Microsoft.ApiManagement/aigateways, not a legacy service. Omitted SKU lets the service select Standard; Standard is the only accepted explicit SKU and requires approval, not source-sizing conversion. Subnet integration requires an existing correctly delegated subnet in the gateway region.
Low-level registration only; no automatic model import or RBAC. Create is not guaranteed create-only.
Inspect and preserve existing authentication and nested properties.
Explicit selected models/operations only. No Foundry onboarding side effects or implicit aliases; callable routes require separate alias assets.
The update --deployment value is JSON, not a deployment name. Explicit protocol/operations are required. The reviewed PATCH does not send If-Match; do not infer atomic concurrency protection.

Requires model ETag and sends If-Match; service enforcement requires authorized verification. Counters are identity/ipAddress arrays. Preserve siblings and inherited scope explicitly; cost limits are optional governance, not APIM quota equivalence.

MCP endpoints and URL or inline OpenAPI documents are distinct source contracts. Restrict OpenAPI operations in the supplied contract; native per-tool filtering is not established. Verify protocol versions, tool names, schemas and behavior.

Supplied endpoints define complete membership; matching nested fields/credentials are preserved, not omitted sources. Endpoint updates internally read secrets with ETag checks. failureMode updates are service-rejected and not exposed.
Appends one source with If-Match; rejects an existing namespace. Service-side stale-ETag rejection needs opt-in live confirmation.
Assignment does not copy source principal IDs or grant backend RBAC. An absent identity on a successfully read gateway is normalized to an empty object.

The reviewed command supports post-create new-RP networking. PATCH preserves unrelated fields; read-back projects backend.subnet into virtualNetworkConfiguration. It does not provide atomic ETag guarantees, provision external resources or perform DNS cutover.
Default-workspace scope, not per-API/product access. Sibling types are preserved. Missing workspace ETag permits an unconditional write; freshness/read-back are not atomic concurrency protection.
Only explicit gateway-wide lifecycle changes; no secret copy/retrieval/rotation. Current service rejects displayName updates.

Reviewed ApplicationInsights connectionString input only; OpenTelemetry/free-form telemetry fields lack a reviewed child schema. Runtime-only credentials, explicit payload capture, and existing external telemetry resources.
Reviewed ApplicationInsights connectionString input only. Preserve unrelated exporter state; no secret-only update inferred from redacted metadata.
Approval of one existing destination connection only; verify its selected peer and provisioning. No source connection copy, endpoint/DNS creation, rejection or deletion.

purpose: Reviewed command and semantic knowledge, not an execution allowlist. Recheck selected operations against the current official CLI.
externalOperations: External Azure CLI writes require exact inventoried targets, roles, scopes and effects plus confirmation; no implicit RBAC or resource provisioning.
